description: Returns one person's business email, mobile number and LinkedIn profile, by a person id from get_loan_companies. Calling or texting the number is subject to the TCPA and Do Not Call rules, which the answer repeats. Each new person opened counts against the account's monthly allowance (50 on Pro, 250 on Team; the same person again that month is free), and the answer says how many are left. Business use only; not a consumer report; no extracting or resale. Without a paid cmbs.news plan it returns a tool error that says so.

person.description: A person id from get_loan_companies (16 hex characters)
